long_biography.plain_text:
Selling his Metalloinvest stake separated Vasily Anisimov from the iron-ore group he had owned with Alisher Usmanov and Andrei Skoch. The exit crystallised value from a career that began in non-ferrous metals trading and freed him to concentrate on property through the Coalco platform he had established in Switzerland.

Sport supplied a parallel public role. Anisimov led the Russian Judo Federation for twelve years, stepping down in 2022. He also relinquished Russian citizenship and transferred control of his remaining Russian property businesses to local managers. Now based in Switzerland, he holds Croatian citizenship and has pursued property in the United Arab Emirates alongside business interests in Kazakhstan and Africa.
